Operations.Name: ApiKeyCreate
Operations.Description:
Creates API Key.

`name` is a user-readable name for key.

Arguments.Name: api_key_create
Arguments.Description: API key configuration data for the new key.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the API key to delete.

Operations.Name: ApiKeyGetInstance
Operations.Description:
Returns instance matching `id`. If `id` is not found, Validation error is raised.

Please see `query` method documentation for `options`.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Query options customize the results returned by a query method. More complete documentation with examples     are covered in the "Query methods" section of the TrueNAS API documentation.

Operations.Name: ApiKeyUpdate
Operations.Description:
Update API Key `id`.

Specify `reset: true` to reset this API Key.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the API key to update.

Models.Name: ApiKeyCreate
Models.Description: API key configuration data for the new key.

Fields.Description: Expiration timestamp for the API key or `null` for no expiration.

Fields.Description: Human-readable name for the API key.

Fields.Name: CreatedAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp when the API key was created.

Fields.Description: Expiration timestamp for the API key or `null` for no expiration.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the API key.

Fields.Name: Keyhash
Fields.Description: Hashed representation of the API key (masked for security).

Fields.Name: Local
Fields.Description: Whether this API key is for local system use only.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human-readable name for the API key.

Fields.Name: Revoked
Fields.Description: Whether the API key has been revoked and is no longer valid.

Fields.Name: RevokedReason
Fields.Description: Reason for API key revocation or `null` if not revoked.

Fields.Name: UserIdentifier
Fields.Description: User ID (numeric) or SID (string) that owns this API key.

Fields.Name: Username
Fields.Description: Username associated with the API key or `null` for system keys.
